samples.summary: revoke() does not filter on `revokedAt: null`, so revoking an already-revoked key succeeds again and rewrites its revokedAt timestamp
samples.evidence: `updateMany({ where: { id, workspaceId, ...creator }, data: { revokedAt: new Date() } })` matches rows whose `revokedAt` is already set. A repeated DELETE on the same key id returns 200 (count === 1) and moves the revocation timestamp forward, losing the original revocation time — the only durable record of when the credential was killed. `list()` filters `revokedAt: null`, so the key is invisible in the UI, but the id is known to the CLI caller and to anyone who saw it once. The idempotent-and-correct form would add `revokedAt: null` to the where and treat count === 0 as the already-revoked/404 case.

samples.summary: revoke() can return `null` from the read-back findUnique, which callers are typed/documented to treat as a key object
samples.evidence: After `updateMany` succeeds the code does a second, non-transactional `findUnique({ where: { id } })`. If the row is deleted between the two statements (e.g. workspace/member cascade, admin cleanup) the handler returns `null` and the endpoint answers 200 with an empty body, while the doc comment says callers report the returned row (`wafflebase api-keys revoke` prints it and the CLI schema declares an `id`). The CLI would then print nothing/`null` for what was a successful revocation.

samples.summary: User guide still documents API Keys as owner-only and claims Settings hides the section from members — both are now false
samples.evidence: Lines 87–98 state "**API Keys** — *owners only*", "A member sees the first three sections and nothing below them", and "The server lets any member *list* a workspace's API keys — creating and revoking are owner-only. The Settings page ... hides the whole **API Keys** section from anyone who isn't an owner". After this change members may create keys, the Settings section renders for every member, and listing is narrowed to the caller's own keys rather than the whole workspace. Nothing in the enforced lanes checks prose accuracy, so this stale description will ship.

samples.summary: API key sandbox fixture lacks the new `createdBy` field, so the owner-only "Created by" column renders "Unknown" in the design/visual scene
samples.evidence: `FIXTURE_API_KEYS` entries carry only id/name/prefix/createdAt/lastUsedAt. `creatorName(apiKey.createdBy)` in workspace-settings.tsx:153 receives `undefined`, `members.find(...)` misses, and the cell falls back to "Unknown" — the workspace-settings scene (whose comment at line 6 says it exists so owner-only sections actually render) will show a misleading column. No crash; the fixture is untyped so no tsc error either.
